categories.label: Editing
categories.description: Changing work with reversible and destructive actions.

categories.label: Loops
categories.description: Continuous state while work, capture, or connection is active.

cues.label: Hover
cues.desc: Fine-pointer discovery without commitment.

cues.label: Press
cues.desc: A control is physically engaged.

cues.label: Release
cues.desc: A pressed control springs back.

cues.label: Double click
cues.desc: A rapid secondary activation.

cues.label: Focus
cues.desc: A control becomes ready for keyboard or text input.

cues.label: Long press
cues.desc: A sustained press reveals a secondary action.

cues.label: Select
cues.desc: An item enters the active set.

cues.label: Deselect
cues.desc: An item leaves the active set.

cues.label: Toggle on
cues.desc: A binary setting becomes active.

cues.label: Toggle off
cues.desc: A binary setting becomes inactive.

cues.label: Check
cues.desc: A checkbox or task enters its completed state.

cues.label: Uncheck
cues.desc: A checkbox or task returns to its incomplete state.

cues.label: Delete
cues.desc: A destructive removal is committed.

cues.label: Cancel
cues.desc: A pending action is abandoned without applying.

cues.label: Undo
cues.desc: The most recent change is reversed.

cues.label: Redo
cues.desc: A reversed change is applied again.

cues.label: Copy
cues.desc: Selected content is placed on the clipboard.

cues.label: Paste
cues.desc: Clipboard content is inserted into the current context.

cues.label: Open
cues.desc: A menu, sheet, panel, or detail view appears.

cues.label: Close
cues.desc: A menu, sheet, panel, or detail view recedes.

cues.label: Back
cues.desc: Navigation returns to the previous place.

cues.label: Forward
cues.desc: Navigation advances to the next place.

cues.label: Expand
cues.desc: A collapsed region reveals more detail.

cues.label: Collapse
cues.desc: An expanded region returns to its compact state.

cues.label: Drag start
cues.desc: An object lifts from its resting place.

cues.label: Drop
cues.desc: A dragged object lands in a valid target.

cues.label: Snap
cues.desc: An object locks into a precise position.

cues.label: Swipe
cues.desc: A touch gesture moves content spatially.

cues.label: Reorder
cues.desc: An item settles into a new position in a sequence.

cues.label: Invalid drop
cues.desc: A dragged object cannot land in the current target.

cues.label: Send
cues.desc: A message or object leaves the user.

cues.label: Receive
cues.desc: A response or object arrives.

cues.label: Notification
cues.desc: New information is available, without urgency.

cues.label: Mention
cues.desc: The user is directly addressed.

cues.label: Typing
cues.desc: A brief key contact during text entry.

cues.label: Reaction
cues.desc: A lightweight social response is added.

cues.label: Success
cues.desc: An action finished with the expected result.

cues.label: Error
cues.desc: An action failed and needs attention.

cues.label: Warning
cues.desc: A risky or consequential state needs review.

cues.label: Info
cues.desc: A neutral system fact is surfaced.

cues.label: Blocked
cues.desc: An action cannot continue in the current state.

cues.label: Retry
cues.desc: A failed action is attempted again.

cues.label: Start
cues.desc: A process, recording, or session begins.

cues.label: Stop
cues.desc: A process, recording, or session ends.

cues.label: Progress step
cues.desc: A discrete step advances inside a longer process.

cues.label: Complete
cues.desc: A multi-step process reaches its final state.

cues.label: Queued
cues.desc: Work is accepted and waiting to begin.

cues.label: Checkpoint
cues.desc: A meaningful stage in a longer process is saved.

cues.label: Loading
cues.desc: A quiet repeating pulse while an interface fetches or waits.

cues.label: Processing
cues.desc: A restrained repeating bed while sustained work is running.

cues.label: Recording
cues.desc: A calm periodic pulse while audio or video capture is live.

cues.label: Connecting
cues.desc: A repeating search pattern while a device or live session connects.

cues.label: Scanning
cues.desc: A spatial sweep repeats while content or devices are discovered.

cues.label: Streaming
cues.desc: A quiet repeating flow while live data or media continues.

cues.label: Play
cues.desc: Media playback begins or resumes.

cues.label: Pause
cues.desc: Media playback pauses at the current position.

cues.label: Seek
cues.desc: The playback position moves to a new point.

cues.label: Volume change
cues.desc: Playback loudness moves to a new level.

cues.label: Skip next
cues.desc: Playback advances to the next item.

cues.label: Skip previous
cues.desc: Playback returns to the previous item.

cues.label: Connect
cues.desc: A device, service, or live session becomes available.

cues.label: Disconnect
cues.desc: A device, service, or live session goes offline.

cues.label: Lock
cues.desc: Access closes or a protected state engages.

cues.label: Unlock
cues.desc: Access opens or a protected state disengages.

cues.label: Wake
cues.desc: A device or dormant interface becomes active.

cues.label: Sleep
cues.desc: A device or interface enters a dormant state.

cues.label: Reward
cues.desc: The user receives a small unit of value.

cues.label: Level up
cues.desc: Capability, rank, or progression increases.

cues.label: Achievement
cues.desc: A rare milestone deserves a fuller celebration.

cues.label: Streak
cues.desc: Repeated participation extends an active streak.

cues.label: Badge
cues.desc: A collectible distinction is awarded.

cues.label: Bonus
cues.desc: An unexpected extra reward is revealed.

cues.label: Add to cart
cues.desc: An item enters a cart or pending order.

cues.label: Remove from cart
cues.desc: An item leaves a cart or pending order.

cues.label: Checkout
cues.desc: A cart advances into the payment flow.

cues.label: Purchase
cues.desc: A paid transaction or value exchange completes.

cues.label: Coupon
cues.desc: A discount or promotional code is accepted.

cues.label: Refund
cues.desc: Value returns after a completed transaction.
